description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementUsage class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin to encapsulate data related to leave entitlement usage, including properties such as ID, number of days, days used, date range, and length in days.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementUsage
classes.description: A DTO class representing the usage details of a leave entitlement, including properties for ID, number of days, days used, relevant date range, and length in days, with constructor and accessor methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize all properties of the LeaveEntitlementUsage object.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave entitlement usage.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave entitlement usage.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days allocated for the leave.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days allocated for the leave.

methods.name: getDaysUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of days used.

methods.name: setDaysUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of days used.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave period.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length of the leave in days.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length of the leave in days.
